correctness.rationale: Every 13-cycle is uniquely written with first site 0 and permuted remaining orbit sites; fixing its first successor partitions the \(12!\) objects into twelve \(11!\) blocks. Exact adjacency masks encode all covered unit intervals. Shortest directed return computed by BFS equals repeated integer convex-hull return, by continuity of adjacent image segments. A complete 479001600-object enumeration found no sorted-characteristic violation, 12 and only 12 equality patterns (exact modular shifts), and 2 and only 2 nonmaximal patterns of sum 77. Independent direct-convexity checker compared 15912 cycle objects; the 2 witnesses were directly checked.

value.rationale: The first factorial-growth order beyond the 2022 manuscript's \(n\le12\) census has 479001600 cyclic patterns. The finding supplies a full new cutoff of an open combinatorial interval-dynamics conjecture and an exact rigidity and second-shell classification for the natural sum of shortest-return characteristics. It is motivated by the conjecture and its sharpness problem, not an arbitrary numerical sample; it does not claim a general theorem.
